mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_teacher_invitation (token_hash, username, nickname, status, expires_at, created_by) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{username}, #{nickname}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, token_hash, username, nickname, status, expires_at, created_by, used_by, created_at, used_at FROM t_teacher_invitation WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, token_hash, username, nickname, status, expires_at, created_by, used_by, created_at, used_at FROM t_teacher_invitation WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
SELECT id, token_hash, username, nickname, status, expires_at, created_by, used_by, created_at, used_at FROM t_teacher_invitation WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, token_hash, username, nickname, status, expires_at, created_by, used_by, created_at, used_at FROM t_teacher_invitation WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
